name: Text animations
description: Caption and title animations, all pure functions of clip progress so preview and export match.

items.name: Fade up
items.description: Rises half a line while it fades in.

items.name: Word reveal
items.description: Word by word, ~9 words a second.

items.name: Pop
items.description: Spring scale with a small overshoot.

items.name: Typewriter
items.description: Characters appear over the first 60% of the clip.

items.name: Slide
items.description: Enters from 8% of the frame width.

items.name: Glass shimmer
items.description: A specular highlight sweeps through the letters.

items.name: Glass rise
items.description: Frosted plate rises and clears behind the text.

items.name: Liquid wave
items.description: Letters ride a sine wave that settles into place.

items.name: Kinetic words
items.description: Each word lands on its own beat with a small overshoot.
